units.note: 1 p = one cup pitch = 1 unit in apps/web/src/scene/layout.ts

axes: +x towards player A's store (A's right), +y up, +z towards player A; origin at the centre of the top face

feet.note: square blocks under the body; every free edge chamfered

heads.axes: head-local: u forward (to the muzzle), v up from the top face, w sideways; neck axis at u = w = 0

outlines.note: side: (u, v); front: (w, v); top: (u, w). Build the head without horns from the three head-only outlines (side is the master).

horn.note: Sweep an oval (depth along normal in the u-v plane, width along w) along (u, v, ±z); ridges sit on the normal (outer) side.

motif.note: (s, h): s along the side, peak at 0, clip to |s| <= repeat/2; h up from the band bottom

band.start: peak of repeat 1 at the middle of player A's side (x = 0, z = +halfWidth); repeats run towards +x
